$comment: The canonical, fixed FailureCode -> RetryClass mapping, per spec/01-domain-model.md#retryclass and Invariant I10 (spec/02-invariants.md#i10). This mapping is not configurable by any adapter, provider, or integrator. esiipayment validate rejects any manifest errors[] entry whose declared retry_class disagrees with this table for its failure_code. Every runtime's retry logic must read from this table (or an exact copy of it), not hardcode a divergent mapping.

highest_severity_case.why: A timeout means the request may or may not have reached and been processed by the provider. Mapping this to SafeToRetry is the highest-severity defect this system is designed to prevent, because a naive retry after an actually-processed request creates a second real payment. See spec/01-domain-model.md#why-providertimeout-is-not-safetoretry and Invariant I4.
